introHtml: Gold adds a touch of warmth and celebration to custom babies and toddlers items, making them ideal for baby showers, gender reveals, or milestone events. Whether you choose gold-tone sippy cups, soft bibs with gold foil imprinting, or hats with metallic embroidery, the color stands out while remaining gender-neutral. These items offer a premium look that parents love to use and share.
